scope: All places linked to world-subject entries in the effective historyAtlasDataset.

sources.name: Provided textbooks and atlases
sources.note: Exact named geographic contexts are linked to existing page citations. No textbook text, image or PDF is redistributed.

limitations: UN M49 is a statistical grouping, not a historical or political border claim. Modern country-level membership does not imply historical sovereignty.
Historical polities use textbook geographic extent at a broad subregion level; overlapping memberships are discovery categories, not dated territorial polygons.

Middle East is an explicit educational overlay (Egypt, Iran and a listed Western Asian set). M49 itself has no Middle East or Northern Asia region. Iran remains Southern Asia in the modern-country M49 mapping.
Country-wide Russia and Türkiye are transcontinental. Siberian cities, Pacific islands and other exceptional geographic contexts use exact reviewed names rather than parent-state geography.
Greenland has its own membership plus Northern America and Arctic. Pacific islands such as Hawaii are grouped by physical geography, not metropolitan sovereignty.
Marine waters use explicit names only. Rivers, canals and inland lakes use their geographic land regions; a mouth or representative point does not determine an entire river basin.
Coordinates are never invented. Coastal misses, ambiguous homonyms and unresolved sites remain unclassified unless an existing country record or explicit source context resolves the region.
Aliases are not consulted. The source dataset includes topic keywords and related landmarks among search aliases, so these cannot establish geographic identity.
Natural Earth is a generalized modern de facto boundary source. Its polygons are a build-time aid only and are not shipped to or displayed by the browser.
